detaileddescription.para: SLR index configuration, AUX/EfuseSynData handling, and eFuse programming are not supported on this platform and are excluded from this example.

To build this application, xilmailbox library must be included in BSP and xilsecure and xilpuf must be in client mode. PUF_LIFECYCLE eFuse bits must be programmed as a prerequisite to run this example.

para.heading: Procedure to link and compile the example for the default ddr less designs

detaileddescription.para: The default linker settings places a software stack, heap and data in DDR memory. For this example to work, any data shared between client running on A72/R5/PL and server running on PMC, should be placed in area which is accessible to both client and server.
By default the cache is enabled for this example
